character: Largest and liveliest Les Arcs village. Split into 4 quarters: Charvet, Villards, Charmettoger, Chantel. Most shops, restaurants, bars, rental outlets. La Folie Douce overhead. Best apres in Les Arcs. La Descente bar (Champagne owners). Benji's Pub. Red Hot Saloon (live music, dance floor).
dining: Widest choice. Chez Clarisse (mountain cheese). Le Chalet de Candice (duck speciality). La Folie Douce (fine dining + apres). Le Refuge du Jambon (cured meats). Benji's Pub (Tex-Mex). Giovanni's (live music).
shopping: Best variety — supermarket, bakery, sports stores, rental, fashion. 100+ shops across 4 quarters.
apres_scene: La Folie Douce (dancing in ski boots until 7pm). La Descente (Champagne bar, vineyard owners). Red Hot Saloon (live music, dance floor). King Mad (happy hour). Jungle Bar. Apocalypse (nightclub until 4am). Benjy's Bar.
activities_nearby: 2-screen cinema. Ice rink. Swimming pool complex. Climbing wall. Snowpark. Bowling. Toboggan runs. 425km Paradiski access.
